name: Positioning {OS}

group.label: 04 · GROW
group.purpose: Turn value into distribution and revenue

tagline: The category you compete in and the claim you own inside it.

commands.name: /positioning
commands.does: Orients: reads the claim ledger and names the next decision.
commands.returns: Current statement, live and contested claims, one next action.

commands.name: /position-map
commands.does: Builds the competitive set with each rival's claim quoted from source.
commands.returns: The competitive map with sources, capture dates and uncontested ground.

commands.name: /position-language
commands.does: Extracts the customer's own vocabulary for the problem.
commands.returns: Ranked verbatim terms with counts and the utterance each came from.

commands.name: /position-category
commands.does: Decides the category, or declares an invented one with its demand cost.
commands.returns: The category decision, its demand verdict and what moves downstream.

commands.name: /position-claim
commands.does: Drafts a candidate claim and forces the exclusion it must name.
commands.returns: The candidate claim, its exclusion and the proof it must carry.

commands.name: /position-test
commands.does: Tests a candidate against customer language and published rival claims.
commands.returns: Pass or fail per test, naming the utterance or rival claim that killed it.

commands.name: /position-statement
commands.does: Assembles the positioning statement from a tested claim.
commands.returns: Category, target, claim, exclusion and proof in one paragraph.

commands.name: /position-ledger
commands.does: Reads, writes and audits the claim ledger.
commands.returns: Ledger entries with evidence, expiry condition, last tester and date.

commands.name: /position-conflict
commands.does: Detects claims that contradict each other and marks the pair contested.
commands.returns: Contested pairs with the evidence on each side and the human decision needed.

commands.name: /position-review
commands.does: Retests every claim that reached its expiry window.
commands.returns: Per claim: holds, contested or expired, with the retest evidence.

commands.name: /position-retire
commands.does: Retires a claim and lists every surface and unit still using it.
commands.returns: A retirement record and the downstream notification list.

commands.name: /position-brief
commands.does: Packages the statement and claim subset one downstream unit needs.
commands.returns: The unit specific brief and what that unit is expected to do with it.

requires_human_approval_for: publishing any claim on an external surface
changing the category, or retiring a category already in market
writing or releasing any claim that names a competitor
overriding recorded customer language with the operator's wording
retiring a live claim that downstream units are currently using
